author: AISL6Y
quote: This is my general opinion, with absolutely no bias toward the game or the company. I’ve played a lot of games, a whole lot, but this isn’t just a case of a few mistakes. The entire game, its concept, and its direction are ****’s start with GTA IV. I originally played The Lost and Damned because Luis was cool and wealthy, and he was on the cover. That was 12 years ago. Four months ago, I went back and replayed the game, this time playing through Niko Bellic, Johnny, and Luis. That’s when I realized the writer behind this game was practically writing with a golden pen. Sure, the writing has some flaws, but it’s still incredible.I’m disappointed because this isn’t the level everyone was waiting **** my opinion, take the last two GTA games and the Red Dead games, throw them all into a blender, and the result would be GTA **** V is good when it comes to Trevor and Michael’s stories, but Franklin feels incomplete. He doesn’t feel like Lamar’s close friend the way he should. I’m talking about character writing across the entire franchise, from the first game to the sixth. There should be at least one character out of every hundred who stands out as truly great, and at least one genuinely good storyline. I don’t see that here.What I see is a conflicting, inconsistent story. I have three reasons that make me question whether the writing team is even the same. There’s an aspect of storytelling they used to excel at, and we’re simply not seeing it **** studio seems to have changed its identity, and bringing back Niko Bellic, a character who’s on the run, is another questionable decision. You might say this isn’t the first time they’ve brought back an old character, but Niko is a character almost everyone loves. Putting him in a game that goes against the kind of person he is doesn’t make sense to me. I don’t think they even realized what went wrong. It feels like they just kept going because it was too late to turn back after the 2022 **** graphics look amazing, absolutely. The animations? Not so much. But the performance? That’s killing the game. Humanity has reached 1,000 frames per second, yet our beloved company can’t even maintain 30, or at least 24. At the very least, there should be a solution to this **** last two generations of gaming have brought some massive leaps forward in the industry. And in my opinion, Rockstar’s biggest mistake was Red Dead Redemption 2.Same quality, just improved, of course. Same characters, just wearing modern clothes. The same thing, over and over **** Red Dead Redemption 2 had never come out, we might have looked at this game as the game of the century. But no, I just don’t see that happening.I feel like the company stopped putting in real effort after 2021, when they discontinued updates for Red Dead **** just to be clear, I actually hate Red Dead. My favorite game of all time is GTA IV. There’s no bias here, just criticism based on an uncomfortable **** in the older games, everyone was treated equally. Kill a Black guy, kill a white guy, kill a Latino, kill an Arab, kill a Jew, kill whoever is standing in front of you. Everyone was treated the same. But now there are certain groups who seem to think they’re above everyone else, and apparently, you aren’t allowed to kill them. I honestly don’t even know what to say anymore. Am I supposed to become an idiot and call this racism? I want to be able to kill whoever I want in a video game. I don’t want special treatment or distinctions between people. You’re ruining the game, for **** **** to the cowards who call themselves critics, or the celebrities who see someone criticizing the game and immediately label it as controversial, when did constructive criticism become controversial? Since when is criticizing a video game considered stirring up controversy? Criticism exists to communicate information, point out flaws, and help correct mistakes, not to create drama around a video game. That’s just ****, I think the idea of rating people, or judging people in general, is a bad thing. But ratings and judgments coming from studios that aren’t even fair? I think that’s even worse.I hope GTA 7 fixes all these issues and gets back to what made the franchise great in the first place, without forcing in the whole “strong female character,” LGBTQ stuff, or the hardworking man coming home from work just to relax and play a game.Best regards.
